verdict.rationale: B claims net debt fell from $35.8bn to $5.5bn and ranks Deere top among peers on leverage. That is an artefact: long-term debt stops being reported after FY2021, which A discloses. B also labels a positive 41.1% incremental margin as 'turned negative'. A misattributes a FY2024 gap to the FY2025 tax rate and mixes net and operating margin in a watch item. Still, its errors are smaller. B has more peer and segment depth.
